scripts.tauri:build:direct: pnpm prepare:executor-runtime && tauri build --features direct-updater --config src-tauri/tauri.direct-updater.conf.json
scripts.tauri:build:embedded: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@nessie/runtime && pnpm prepare:executor-runtime && node scripts/build-embedded-shell.mjs
scripts.tauri:build:executor: pnpm prepare:executor-runtime && node scripts/require-signing-team.mjs && pnpm prepare:executor-menubar && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.executor-menubar.conf.json
scripts.tauri:build:appstore: node scripts/require-signing-team.mjs && node scripts/prepare-appstore-profile.mjs && tauri build --bundles app --config src-tauri/tauri.appstore.conf.json
